cards.card_text: He tells them to demand a high dowry and an expensive gift, and he'll give whatever they ask, if they'll only give him the girl as his wife.
cards.verse_text: Demand a high dowry and an expensive gift, and I will give you whatever you ask.
cards.snippet: Demand a high dowry and an expensive gift, and I will give you whatever you ask.

cards.card_text: The servants report back, and Saul names his price: “The king desires no other dowry but a hundred Philistine foreskins as revenge on his enemies.” But Saul intends to cause David's death at the hands of the Philistines.
cards.verse_text: Saul replied, “Say to David, ‘The king desires no other dowry but a hundred Philistine foreskins as revenge on his enemies.’” But Saul intended to cause David’s death at the hands of the Philistines.
cards.snippet: Saul replied, “Say to David, ‘The king desires no other dowry but a hundred Philistine foreskins as revenge on his enemies.’” But Saul…

cards.card_text: Then he gave it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon's wife.
cards.verse_text: He had set it on fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
cards.snippet: …the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
